brief: Create an array of a given length
description: Create a new mutable array of the given length where every entry is value, or undefined when value is not passed (ECMAScript new Array(n).fill(v), with no holes). Useful when you want a known length up front before assigning entries; assigning one past the end appends, further is an error. A computed array is create_array(n)->map(function(v, i) { ... }). Length must be a non-negative integer and must not exceed 1,000,000. This is a length-based constructor, not a conversion function (see also array(...), which builds from elements).

parameters.description: Number of entries (0 or more, up to the maximum).
parameters.name: length

parameters.description: The value of every entry. A function is stored as the entry, not called; write create_array(n)->map(fn) for computed entries. If not passed, every entry is undefined.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: A new array of the requested length; each entry is value, or undefined.

errorsThrown.reason: length is negative or exceeds the maximum allowed
